Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0017 2026-04-23
SHIFT NOTES — Electrical Review Appointments Across
Lunch Relief
Date: 2026-04-23
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
09:10 — Review desk note from PERSON-0028 for TEAM-0004.
Arrange electrical discussion appointments around lunch relief
beginning at 11:40. ISSUE-0105 and TASK-0281 are the reference
pair for the folder used in this handover.
10:05 — The roster clerk will confirm which reviewer can
receive work presented in the awaiting_review category during
the relief interval. Put the reviewer's name and availability
on the appointment sheet. A calendar opening alone is not
confirmation that the reviewer can take the discussion.
11:20 — If a reviewer changes, retain the earlier appointment
and write the substitute's name in the dated margin. Tell the
collecting coordinator which papers the substitute expects.
Avoid asking that coordinator to assemble the same packet
again under a different meeting heading.
13:10 — The returning desk lead checks the appointment margin
before resuming calls. Any discussion that moved during relief
needs a new contact time beside the old entry. Keep the folder
at the electrical review shelf until the receiving person
knows where to find it.
Next-shift list
— Confirm the relief reviewer directly with the roster clerk.
— Read the substitution margin before contacting the
collecting coordinator.
Carry the expected paper-delivery time into the afternoon
appointment sheet, keeping it separate from the reviewer's
D. Worker 0028
Demo Worker 0028, Demo Team 04
